testo:
Mach Fighter
Double Breaker
■ Once per turn, when you put a Dragon, you may put the top 2 cards of your deck into your mana zone tapped. Then you may return a dragon card from your mana zone to your hand.
■ Whenever you play a Student Council Group card, you may tap cards in your mana zone as if they had all civilizations.
